notes:
**The app is free. The payment path is gone, not switched off.** Play Billing, the UPI screen, licence keys, the subscription record, the trial clock and the countdown banner are deleted. Nothing is locked, nothing runs out, there is no plan to be on. Reaching people comes first, and when there is a way to pay it will be one we build ourselves.

**Your backtests now keep their history.** The candle archive - whatever depth your own broker grants, stored on your phone - existed in the code and nothing read or wrote it. So every backtest asked the broker again for bars it had already been given, and a window your broker refused today was gone even if it had been served last week. It keeps them now.

**A backup file you own.** No sign-in, nothing uploaded: one file with your account, watchlists, alerts, drawings and every rule you have built. And every rule you built was, until now, the one thing no backup carried - not the cloud copy either.

**Your broker keys have not moved and will not.** They stay in this phone's keystore, out of every backup, out of the cloud, out of the file. That is the same in the Play build.
